issue: Refreshing glycan screening from an already glycan-filtered pool could drop the rejected entries and allow them back into the next selection.
correction: Compute the screening population with every other gate applied but the glycan gate disabled; screening includes all potential candidates on every refresh. The final selector applies the resulting complete gate.
required_final_test: Every final selected sequence has an explicit passing glycan record, every eligible-before-glycan sequence has a screening record, and a repeated selection is idempotent.
